failure_reason:
Etsy could not be reached by any available path, for two independent reasons. (1) TRANSPORT: this machine's IPv4 egress is dead (root cause established by the AllModern worker; only hosts with AAAA records are reachable). Etsy publishes NO AAAA record - 'nslookup -type=AAAA www.etsy.com' returns the name with no address, and 'curl -6 https://www.etsy.com/c/home-and-living' fails with exit 6 (could not resolve host). etsy.com, openapi.etsy.com, api.etsy.com and i.etsystatic.com are likewise A-only. Direct IPv4 attempts therefore never complete a TCP handshake: curl 'code=000 connect=0.000000' on repeated spaced retries, requests 'ConnectTimeoutError: Connection to www.etsy.com timed out (connect timeout=45)', WebFetch 'connect ECONNREFUSED 151.101.107.42:443', raw /dev/tcp to 151.101.1.42:443 fails. All four Fastly anycast edges (151.101.1.42, .65.42, .129.42, .193.42) via curl --resolve, plus plain HTTP on port 80, all return 000. Confirmed not a sandbox fault (identical with the Bash sandbox disabled) and not a DNS fault (A records resolve correctly: www.etsy.com -> zone2.www.etsy.com -> h3.etsy.map.fastly.net -> 151.101.107.42). (2) THE TRANSLATE.GOOG WORKAROUND DOES NOT WORK FOR ETSY. https://www-etsy-com.translate.goog/?_x_tr_sl=en&_x_tr_tl=es&_x_tr_hl=en returns HTTP 400 carrying Google Translate's own error page - visible text 'Google Translate / Translate / Can't translate this page / Go to original page' - for every Etsy path tried: /, /c/home-and-living, /c/home-and-living/decor, /search?q=vase. Reproduced on repeat attempts, across parameter variants (_x_tr_sl=auto; _x_tr_sl=es&_x_tr_tl=en; _x_tr_tl=fr with _x_tr_pto=wapp), and via the apex host etsy-com.translate.goog (302 -> www-etsy-com.translate.goog -> same 400). The proxy host itself is reachable over IPv6, so this is Etsy's origin refusing Google Translate's fetcher, not a transport failure. Note: https://www-etsy-com.translate.goog/robots.txt returns 200 but its 26-byte body is 'User-agent: *\nDisallow: /', which is translate.goog's own robots.txt and not Etsy's - it is not evidence of a working proxied path. Consistent with all of the above, an earlier attempt through the r.jina.ai reader returned Etsy's DataDome interstitial directly: title 'etsy.com', body '

Please enable JS and disable any ad blocker

', inline script 'var dd={"rt":"i","cid":"AHrlqAAAAAMArCLik_BGEIoAIiL9NQ==","hsh":"D013AA612AB2224D03B2318D0F5B19",...,"host":"geo.captcha-delivery.com",...}' loading https://ct.captcha-delivery.com/i.js; jina's browser engine reported 'Warning: This page maybe requiring CAPTCHA, please make sure you are authorized to access this page' with empty content. Per instruction, no attempt was made to solve or bypass the challenge and no further relays were hunted. No Etsy page, category listing or result count was ever observed, so no row could be evidenced and none were written.
notes: Zero rows fabricated. Status is 'failed' rather than 'partial' because not a single sub-category URL could be verified as live - writing unverified URLs with null qty would be invention, not extraction. Guidance for a real-browser pass: Etsy's Home & Living department is https://www.etsy.com/c/home-and-living; the in-scope decor sub-trees are /c/home-and-living/decor (decorative objects, vases, candles & holders, picture frames & displays), /c/home-and-living/home-decor, /c/home-and-living/lighting, and the glassware / drinkware / dinnerware branches of /c/home-and-living/kitchen-and-dining. Two blockers will still apply in a browser: Etsy is DataDome-protected so an interstitial may need to clear, and - more importantly - Etsy is a marketplace that renders capped/rounded result counts ('1,000,000+ results', '10,000+ results'). Any count carrying a '+' suffix or an obviously rounded magnitude is a display cap, NOT an exact total, and must be written as qty null with flag 'MANUAL REVIEW: site displays a capped/rounded count'. Accept a qty only where Etsy prints a bare, unrounded integer with no '+'. Expect most or all Etsy rows to end up null on that basis even from a working browser session.
